description.en-US:
Task spaces of AI context you inject into any chat composer, sync and guard, under your control.

**Who it is for:** people who want to see foxspace work in their own browser before they build on the foxspace library.

**What leaves your computer:** nothing. foxspace has no server, sends no data off this device, and has no analytics.

**Permissions**

- Storage: keep a value in your browser that the toolbar popup shows.

The source code is MIT licensed.

version.approval_notes: The uploaded source.zip is the git tree of this release. To build: install Node 24 and pnpm (corepack enable), run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm build:ext`. The output is dist-ext/. esbuild bundles extension/*.js; the other files are copied unmodified. To try it: click the toolbar button. The popup shows the value that the background script stores at install. No account is needed.
